code: const runningKeyCipher={name:'Running Key',keyRequired:true,func:(text,operation,key)=>{if(!key)throw new Error('Key is required for Running Key cipher');const keyUpper=key.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g,'');const cleanedText=text.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g,'');if(keyUpper.length<cleanedText.length){throw new Error('Key must be at least as long as the text');}let result='';for(let i=0;i<cleanedText.length;i++){const textCode=cleanedText.charCodeAt(i)-65;const keyCode=keyUpper.charCodeAt(i)-65;let newCode;if(operation==='encrypt'){newCode=(textCode+keyCode)%26;}else{newCode=(textCode-keyCode+26)%26;}result+=String.fromCharCode(newCode+65);}return result;}};export default runningKeyCipher;
